title: JIRC 2015
text: Congratulations to SUFFOC juniors Matthew Clarke, Tim Harrison, Bryn Wilkinson, Roderick Mansel and Bronwen Mansel who were members of the successful EAJS team at the Junior Inter-regional Championships (JIRC) 2015. The competition, organised by the WMOA, was held at Brereton Spurs, Rugeley (individual event) and at Oldacre, Brocton (relay), and the EAOA team ended in 7th position, some 3 places higher than in recent years! Further details can be seen on the JROS website, with additional photos on the SuffOC and EAJS Facebook pages. Our thanks to the coaches and to all those who supported the team at this weekend event.
